title: Venezuelan Winey Bake
description: A hearty, comforting bake infused with the flavors of Venezuela and a hint of wine. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Slice the bake into 1-inch thick rounds.
In a large bowl, whisk together Venezuelan wine and creamy sauce.
Add the sliced bake to the bowl and toss to coat.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the radish to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the bake to a baking dish and top with the radish mixture.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the bake is tender and the top is golden brown.
